description: BF202102-S006 is an Africa-Press discovery lead about the planned UCRB transport strike. Its body was not read. Three attempts are retained: web-reader timeout, default HTTPS DNS failure, and an ordinary HTTPS request that returned HTTP 403 before the saved publisher-wide guard was surfaced. The structured guard now records the exact observed host and denial, cites Zambia 2021-01 S012 and Ethiopia 2021-01 ETH202101-S175, and the fresh post-record receipt returns hold. The manual publisher review missed the old broad prose guard before these attempts; this deviation is not retroactively authorized.
required_followup: Do not request Africa-Press or a same-story copy. If the transport lead is reviewed later, use a separately published and permitted source with an exact host/origin prescreen.

description: Wakat Séra S013 had two wrapper opens at 06:10:57.426Z and 06:11:01.901Z. The first had a fresh receipt; there was no new receipt between these requests. Both returned only URL/title and a line count, with no surfaced body. A fresh stable receipt and full manual review preceded the third attempt at 06:12:21.187Z, which surfaced the relevant body. The missing second-attempt receipt is preserved as a protocol deviation.
required_followup: Retain the attempt history; do not retroactively authorize the duplicate open. The body claims are limited to the third, properly gated attempt.
